notes: North is up. Printed names: 'E. McMILLEN' (large label; small labels read 'E. McMILLIAN' and 'McMILLAN') - written East McMillan Street so it joins sheets 191-195; 'CUMBERLAND (NOT OPEN)' (40'); 'READING RD.' (80' north of Kinsey/Morgan, printed 70' near Helen); 'BENNINGTON (WILLIAM) (NOT OPEN)' (old name William; 50'); 'IOWA AV. (IRWIN)' north of Morgan and 'IOWA AV. (VIOLA)' south of Morgan (old names; same street, continuous); 'DOVER' (30', only its west line is on this sheet, centre taken as west line + 52 px); 'KINSLEY AV.' west of Reading - printed KINSLEY here but KINSEY AV. on sheets 192/193, so written Kinsey Avenue to join; 'MORGAN' east of Reading; 'BURNET AV.' (50', a faint '(NOT OPEN)' is pencilled in it); 'HELEN'. Names without suffix written with 'Street'. Kinsey changes name to Morgan at Reading Road (both on the same line), so that crossing is recorded under both names. McMillan crosses Reading Road on an 'IRON BRIDGE' (grade-separated: dashed bridge lines span Reading) - the point is still the centreline crossing. Reading Road continues north of McMillan into the Volume 4 area. Cumberland, Bennington, Iowa and Dover meet McMillan as T (north block line continuous, Volume 4 side). Bennington and Dover end at Morgan (T); Iowa crosses Morgan and runs off the bottom. Burnet meets Helen from the north (centre ~1092 at Helen) and an unlabelled 50' street continues south of Helen at x 1024-1200 (centre 1112, toward sheets 184/185) - treated as Burnet's continuation and recorded as one cross at the mean; the two centrelines are ~20 px apart. Helen runs from the left edge east to Reading Road and stops there (T); east of Reading at that level is sheet 185 ground. A 'WILKINSON' label and an angled lot line sit in the bottom-right corner (x~3640-3860, y~4210-4500), but no Wilkinson street lines or crossing with Iowa can be identified on the paper (paper ends ~y 4575), so no Wilkinson point is recorded here. The dash-dot line at y~4385-4395 across the bottom is not a street. No alleys.
